description: Zip orders (Cookiebox trailing range orders, program `ZiPzPbbM…`) of a wallet — yours by default, or `owner` = any address or .cook name. Read straight from the program; no key needed. A Zip sells one token for another across a price range and never fills back: it rests as a one-sided Cookiebox CLMM position that the Cookiebox keeper trails, each step paying the filled part (plus the LP fees earned) to the owner's wallet. Prices are **receive per sell** (what one sold token fetches; see `priceUnit`): each order reports what it sells and receives, its `from`–`to` range, the current price, what is left in it (`inPosition`), who may crank it, and a `status` with the keeper's next move in words: `filling`, `waiting` (price not far enough past the edge, or inside the last step), `fully-filled` (the keeper pays out and closes the order next), `paused` (NFT delegation gone, a transfer hook with no published extra-account list, a payout account closed, or a tick array missing — start_zip with the order's `positionMint` repairs all but the hook), `empty`, `filled` (paid out; the empty position is left — stop_zip with its NFT mint closes it and returns its rent), or `stale` (position gone; stop_zip refunds the order's rent).

owner.description: wallet address or .cook name; defaults to the configured wallet

name: get_zip_orders
title: Zip orders
